```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 90, message = FALSE)
has_mvln <- requireNamespace("mvtnorm", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = TRUE)
has_ss3diags <- requireNamespace("ss3diags", quietly = TRUE)
library(ss3diags2)
library(ggplot2)
```

`ss3diags2` extracts observations and outputs of Stock Synthesis (SS3) models, read with `r4ss::SS_output()`, into
long `data.table` tables that convert to FLR objects (`FLQuants`, `FLIndices`, `FLStockR`, `FLPar`), and plots them
with `ggplot2`. Inputs are shaped for JABBA3 and FLicc. This guide shows the functionality on `ss3simple`, the
simulated "simple_small" model of r4ss. It is the example used by the PIFSC version of ss3diags
(<https://github.com/PIFSCstockassessments/ss3diags>), so results can be compared directly. A second vignette,
*Season-, sex- and area-structured models*, applies the tools to the northern shrimp assessment (four seasons,
hermaphrodite, two areas, six area-specific fleets) and covers the management quantities: stock status with MVLN
uncertainty, Kobe plots and the timing of F and SSB, production function, partial F and partial impact.

| ss3diags                     | ss3diags2                                              |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `SSplotRunstest()`, `SSrunstest()` | `ss3_runs()`, `ss3plot_runs()` (indices, mean length, mean age) |
| `SSplotJABBAres()`, `SSrmse()` | `ss3plot_jres()`                                      |
| `SSplotRetro()`, `SShcbias()`  | `ss3_retro()`, `ss3_mohn()`, `ss3plot_retro()`        |
| `SSplotHCxval()`, `SSmase()`   | `ss3_hindcast()`, `ss3plot_hcxval()`                  |
| `SSdeltaMVLN()`, `SSplotKobe()` | `ss3mvln()`, `ss3stk()`, `ss3plot_trj()`, `ss3plot_kobe()` |
| (Pearson residuals in r4ss)  | `ss3_resid()` (OSA), `ss3plot_resid()`                 |

# 1. Fleets and observations

```{r obs}
data(ss3simple)
ss3_fleets(ss3simple)
ct  <- ss3_catch(ss3simple)                  # FLQuants by fleet
idx <- ss3_indices(ss3simple)                # FLIndices of FLIndexBiomass, input SE in index.var
lfd <- ss3_lencomp(ss3simple)                # FLQuants by fleet, sex as unit
afd <- ss3_agecomp(ss3simple)
ss3plot_data(catch = ct, indices = idx, lencomp = lfd, agecomp = afd)
```

Each extractor has `what = "exp"` for the model fit, which the plots overlay:

```{r fits}
ss3plot_indices(idx, fit = ss3_indices(ss3simple, what = "exp"))
ss3plot_comps(lfd, fit = ss3_lencomp(ss3simple, what = "exp"), by = "unit")
ss3plot_comps(afd, type = "bubble", by = "unit")
```

`ss2jabba3()` and `ss2flicc()` return the same observations shaped as JABBA3 and FLicc inputs (catch in weight by
fleet, annual indices with input SEs; length compositions by gear on common bins and years).

# 2. Life history and growth

`ss3_lhpar()` returns an `FLPar` of growth, maturity, length-weight and M by sex (unit), the FLicc `lhpar`. Growth
curves by sex can be overlaid on the length compositions as ridges, observed and expected, with cohort tracks.

```{r growth}
lh <- ss3_lhpar(ss3simple)
lh
ss3plot_growth(ss3simple, lfd = lfd)
```

```{r ridges, fig.height = 7}
ss3plot_ridges(lfd, fit = ss3_lencomp(ss3simple, what = "exp"), type = "both", fleets = "SURVEY1", lhpar = lh)
```

# 3. Residual diagnostics

One-step-ahead (OSA) residuals follow the SS3 likelihood (multinomial, or Dirichlet-multinomial with the precision
implied by the SS3 effective sample size; Trijoulet et al. 2023). Cohort tracks of von Bertalanffy growth by sex
help to see year classes. `fleets =` and `units =` select panels.

```{r osa, fig.height = 6}
rl <- ss3_resid(ss3simple)                   # length
ss3plot_resid(rl, lhpar = lh)
ss3plot_resid(ss3_resid(ss3simple, "age"), units = "F")
ss3plot_resid(rl, type = "qq")
```

OSA residuals are conditional on the smaller bins: too few small fish gives negative residuals at small lengths
and positive residuals at larger lengths.

Runs tests on the log residuals of the indices (or of mean length or age) with 3-sigma limits, and the joint
residual plot:

```{r runs}
ss3_runs(ss3simple)
ss3plot_runs(ss3simple)
ss3plot_runs(ss3simple, quant = "len")
ss3plot_jres(ss3simple)
```

Retrospective analysis and hindcast cross-validation need a set of SS3 runs with peels, read with
`r4ss::SSgetoutput()` and `r4ss::SSsummarize()`:

```{r retro, eval = TRUE}
data(retro.sma)                              # shortfin mako peels (cookbook)
rt <- ss3_retro(retro.sma)
ss3_mohn(rt, quants = c("SSB", "F"))
ss3plot_retro(rt, type = c("SSB", "F"))
hc <- ss3_hindcast(retro.sma)
hc$mase
ss3plot_hcxval(hc)
```

# 4. Selectivity and recruitment

```{r sel}
ss3plot_sel(ss3_sel(ss3simple))
ss3plot_sr(ss3simple)
ss3plot_sr(ss3simple, type = "devs")
```

# 5. Management quantities

Stock status with MVLN uncertainty (`ss3stk()`, `ss3mvln()`), trajectories with reference points, Kobe plots and
the timing of F and SSB, the production function, F-at-age, partial F and the partial impact of fleets are shown
in the vignette *Season-, sex- and area-structured models* on the northern shrimp assessment, where several fleets
and areas make them informative: `vignette("pandalus", package = "ss3diags2")`.

# References

Trijoulet, V., Albertsen, C.M., Kristensen, K., Legault, C.M., Miller, T.J. and Nielsen, A. (2023). Model validation
for compositional data in stock assessment models: calculating residuals with correct properties. Fisheries
Research, 257: 106487.
